user.title: E-REDES Account
user.description:
Enter your E-REDES Balcao Digital token and CPE code.

To get your token:
1. Log into balcaodigital.e-redes.pt
2. Open browser dev tools (F12)
3. Go to Application > Cookies
4. Copy the 'aat' cookie value

data_description.aat_token: The 'aat' cookie value from your browser session
data_description.cpe: Your electricity meter CPE code (e.g., PT0002000012345678XX)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with E-REDES
reauth_confirm.description:
Your E-REDES session has expired. Please enter a new token for CPE {cpe}.

To get your token:
1. Log into balcaodigital.e-redes.pt
2. Open browser dev tools (F12)
3. Go to Application > Cookies
4. Copy the 'aat' cookie value
